svg.title: Give each variant its own data.
svg.desc: Discriminated Unions allow expressing commands, states, and results with distinct payloads, they are struct-based and lightweight: storage is compact and requires no additional heap allocation. Actual union declarations from the Unity showcase, displayed in Rider
